name: INKY Death Road
summary: INKY Death Road is a top-down arcade score-attack game in which the player guides a soccer ball across a busy highway, scoring it into goals on either verge while dodging oncoming traffic. A single collision ends the run, and a draining stamina bar must be refilled to stay in play. Higher scores promote the player through five trophy tiers, from paper to platinum. The game uses a hand-drawn notebook-paper art style and a soundtrack built around the oud.
